answer: The timber holds work receipts rather than names, so the quill of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, unlocked only after continuous uptime, rewards vest against future work. What survives to the meadow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
